title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on Ukrainian children forcibly deported or living in Russian-occupied territories in Ukraine
part_text: Condemns, in the strongest possible terms, Russia’s systematic deportation, forcible transfer, illegal adoption, forced Russification, indoctrination and militarisation of Ukrainian children, including with the involvement of Belarus and the DPRK; demands the immediate cessation of these practices and reiterates that Russia bears full responsibility for respecting the rights of children under its control; mourns the hundreds of innocent Ukrainian children whose lives have been lost since the start of the full-scale invasion;
